name: comp-314

frames.best_why: Frame 3 shows the full dialog with icon, both text lines and both buttons, cursor clear.

tagline: A button opens a warning panel asking if you really want to delete.
summary: An outlined trigger button opens a centred alert with a circled warning icon, a short question, a line of explanation, and Cancel and Confirm actions.
appearance: Closed, it is a single outlined button. Open, a dark rounded panel floats over a dimmed page: a thin circle icon at the left of a bold Are you sure? heading, two grey text lines, a divider, then Cancel and a white Confirm at the lower right.
behaviour: Clicking the trigger fades the panel in over a dimmed background. Cancel, Confirm or an outside click closes it with a short scale and fade.
demo_content: Trigger reads Alert dialog with icon; the panel asks Are you sure? about deleting the account.
use_when: Before a destructive or irreversible action, to ask for explicit confirmation.
avoid_when: The question, explanation and button labels are fixed in the file, so new copy needs a source edit.
customise: Title, description, trigger text and button labels are hardcoded; the component accepts no props.
weight_why: One trigger and one dialog; nothing runs until it opens.

a11y.note: The dialog primitive traps focus and Esc closes it, and the icon is hidden; the file itself ignores reduced motion.

polish_why: Balanced dialog with a clear icon; styling is the stock primitive with no flourishes.
title: Alert Dialog With Icon
